d:
The Hawks defeated the Hornets, 111-97 tonight in Atlanta. Jalen Johnson finished with a team-high 26 points along with 6 rebounds and 6 assists for the Hawks, while Aaron Wiggins tallied 19 points, 4 three pointers and 3 assists in the game. Moussa Diabaté recorded 21 points, 15 rebounds and 2 assists. The Hawks improve their record to 10-6 with the win, while the Hornets fall to 4-11 for the season.
